note: Triennial election of the 21 electoral divisions of Downpatrick rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Twenty-four nominations were lodged; four divisions were contested and one withdrawal left Raholp uncontested. Ardglass and Ballynahinch are recorded from the report of the new council's first monthly meeting (Dromore Weekly Times, 21 June 1952), with their divisions from the 1949 return (round 2, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed after a withdrawal; he had been opposed by W. M'Ilroy (N.). Returned unopposed.
